# Tiwut Web SDK

A massive, modular, dependency-free HTML/CSS/JS Website SDK.

## Features
- **50 Distinct Themes**: A mix of light, dark, modern, clean, and retro themes using CSS Variables.
- **Dependency-Free**: Pure HTML, CSS, and vanilla JS. No Tailwind, no external libraries.
- **Glassmorphism & Blurs**: Achieved purely through CSS `backdrop-filter`.
- **Modular Sub-Libraries**: Core, Themes, Components, and Utils are designed as independent blocks for use in other projects.
- **Massive Icon Library**: Integrated with the Tiwut Icon Library (20,000+ SVGs).

## Structure
- [`core/`](./core) - Base resets and CSS utilities.
- [`themes/`](./themes) - Theme variable definitions and dynamic switcher.
- [`components/`](./components) - Reusable UI elements (buttons, cards, etc.).
- [`utils/`](./utils) - JS utility helpers.
- [`icons/`](./icons) - The imported Tiwut Icon Library.
- [`examples/`](./examples) - Example integrations.
